dct_description_sm: Abstract: This polygon layer contains the boundaries of the five United States Postal Service (USPS) ZIP code areas in the city of Cambridge, Massachusetts.
Purpose: Created for informational purposes only. Official zip code information should be verified at the U.S. Postal Service website.
